entities.summary: Radel Fazleyev is a Russian professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for Humo Tashkent of the Pro Hokei Ligasy (KAZ). He was drafted in the sixth round of the 2014 NHL Entry Draft by the Philadelphia Flyers.
